versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-cfw-status-overview 0.0.2

- Improved clarity on CLI execution: explicitly requires immediate command execution and forbids API substitutions.
- Enforced use of Aliyun CLI AI-mode at start/end of workflow; added required user-agent string for all CLI invocations.
- Updated prerequisites: Aliyun CLI version >= 3.3.3 and mandatory plugin update steps.
- Strengthened credential handling rules: never output or log any part of Access Key data.
- Expanded forbidden API substitutions to ensure only the documented CLI commands are used in the workflow.
- Enhanced error handling instructions and emphasized correct exit procedures for AI-mode.

Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Firewall Status Overview Skill.

- Provides a one-click overview of Cloud Firewall status, including asset management, firewall switch status (Internet/VPC/NAT), and traffic trends.
- Strictly executes via `aliyun cloudfw ...` CLI commands—no log files, server access, or user input required.
- Built-in error handling for API failures with partial results reporting.
- Automatic parameter handling and region selection, with no user confirmation needed unless specified.
- Prerequisite checks for Aliyun CLI version and credential/configuration status.
